# has destruction event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasDestructionEvent`](gmeow-hasDestructionEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasDestructionEvent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lifecycle`](../../slices/lifecycle.md)

Links an entity to the event that ended its existence — the general form of death (person), dissolution (organization), destruction (place), or retirement (frame, software). Non-functional: competing standpoint-indexed destruction claims coexist. A [`Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md)'s death event is ALSO typed [`gmeow:eventTypeDeath`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeDeath.md). Suppression ([`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false) is a display contract; destruction is an ontic fact — the entity is retained, merely marked as no longer extant.
